title: Haystack-DS+ISW Parameter Trade-Off Security
summary: Known attacks impose parameter constraints on Haystack-DS+ISW, but its security across the full ciphertext-size, share, and slot trade-off remains to be characterized.

formal_statement.body: For Haystack-DS+ISW, known $\mathrm{HDDA}$, $\mathrm{HODCA}$, $\mathrm{LSPN}$, and generic birthday attacks yield parameter constraints involving the ciphertext size $m$, which is also the sliding-window size in trace-based attacks, the number of shares $\ell$, and the number of slots $d$. These constraints leave a trade-off among $m$, $\ell$, and $d$. Characterize the security of Haystack-DS+ISW at every point in this parameter trade-off space.

scope.domain: Cryptanalysis and parameter security of the Haystack-DS+ISW symmetric cipher.
parameters: m: ciphertext size and sliding-window size in trace-based attacks
scope.unresolved_remainder: Characterize the security of Haystack-DS+ISW at every point in the trade-off among m, ℓ, and d.

progress.summary: The source derives parameter constraints from known HDDA, HODCA, LSPN, and generic birthday attacks, then presents security across the resulting parameter trade-off as an interesting question.
